Introduction

Online learning has grown quickly over the last decade. Many universities now offer full degrees through digital platforms (Smith, 2020). Students value the flexibility, although some report feeling isolated.

Brown and Lee (2018) found that structured feedback improves completion rates. Their study followed four hundred learners across two years.

Conclusion

Careful course design matters more than the platform itself. Further research should compare different feedback methods.

References

Brown, K., & Lee, M. (2018). Feedback in online courses. Education Review, 12(3), 45-67.
Smith, J. (2020). Digital degrees. Academic Press.
